expectation.statement: 1,755/490 ~= 3.6 cycles/field vs expected ~10-12 for an annual crop; pass = cycles ~= 10-12/field OR a documented reason
expectation.documented_reason_v1: v1 detector (src/ssl_anomaly/phenology/cycles.py) keeps only intervals with 180 <= length <= 540 days and silently skips the rest (_build_cycles_from_boundaries, cycles.py:298-301); fields with <30 usable observations return no cycles at all (cycles.py:165-167). Sugarcane cycles concentrate at the 350-380 d median, so the 540 d cap and detector merges bound the count per field; 12 of 490 fields have zero cycles.
expectation.documented_reason_v2: v2 = fused detector (cycles_490_v2.provenance.json, git cfa57d86): v1 harvests + multi-index fusion candidates recover censored/skipped windows (4,458 rows, 3,478 non-censored, all 490 fields), but the same 180-540 d window rule still applies, so per-field counts remain below the naive 10-12 annual-crop expectation (measured 9.10 total / 7.10 non-censored per field). The expectation assumes one cycle per year with zero censoring or merging; the measured median length (v2 clean 366.0 d) is consistent with annual sugarcane, so the shortfall is attributable to censoring at the series edges and detector merges, not to missing years.
